messages.subject: Thread hijacking
parts:
Hi:

I just got a note from the original poster of this thread:
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/1896fc9421f028f6

who was concerned that his message and potential follow-up responses
did not make it to the list (or to him). Evidently, by responding to
both the original poster and the follow-up poster, I inadvertently
changed the name of the thread twice. This does not enthrall me - I
sympathize with the consternation of the OP, who appears to be a
first-time poster.

PLEASE, if you have a question that does not have a bearing on an
existing thread, start a new one. If you follow the thread above,
you'll notice how its name has changed several times in the process.
This is not productive, especially for archival purposes. If you've
managed to find the ggplot2 list, you've also managed to find its
e-mail address, which is posted near the bottom of the web page
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2 . Therefore, it should be
simple to start a new thread. Many have done so in the past...

Dennis
